model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability terms for mistralv0.2-Base and fine-tuned models across different specialties. The horizontal axis represents per-specialty terms, displaying the categories ‘Cardio’, ‘Gastro’, ‘Infect’, ‘Neuro’, and ‘Pediatrics’ in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability”, ranges from -27 to -22, with a linear scale and tick intervals of approximately 1. The blue bar representing ‘MISTRAlv0.2-Base’ is consistently positioned at approximately -25.5, while the orange bars represent fine-tuned models on ‘Cardio’, ‘Gastro’, ‘Infect’, ‘Neuro’, and ‘Pediatrics’, each with values ranging from -23.3 to -23.8.  All bars are displayed without any visual emphasis, and they are not sorted in any particular order.
